cells.value: Prepared 05 Nov 2026 from 'Skanda_coloumns_updtaded_2.xlsx' - content as written, format only

Skanda's tables in the team data-dictionary format: analytics.product_events, analytics.discovery_impressions, safety.report_evidence, audit.audit_product_event. Text, constraints, value lists and indexes are copied as he wrote them - no changes or suggestions.
Tables -> Data Dictionary (every column) -> Value Lists (table > column > values) -> Index Dictionary -> Relationships.
Columns marked (optional) in his sheet are kept with that label.
PK = primary key. FK = link to another table. UNIQUE = no duplicates. CHECK = rule the database enforces.
'Columns' counted live from the Data Dictionary sheet.
